sources.role: cross-vintage check for persistent paths and planting divisions
cross-vintage check for persistent paths and planting divisions

assumptions: The four MassGIS parcel members (215_1, 215_29, 215_31, and 215_32) are authoritative only for assessor-parcel context; together they total 23.86 acres and closely approximate the published 24-acre campus, but they are not evidence for interior garden boundaries.
The application local plane uses x east, y south, and inches, matching screen orientation while retaining a reversible CRS84 origin.
Visible planting edges vary by season, so persistent paths and repeated plot divisions across 2019, 2021, and 2025 receive more weight than crop edges.
Bed centers and dimensions are aerial interpretations for planning and remain editable; none are survey-grade observations.
The official visitor map is authoritative for the numbered 1–33 landmark names and schematic relationships, not for metric geometry.

The visitor-map page is rotated: north is approximately 33 degrees counterclockwise from page-up. A roughly +30 to +33 degree browser bearing may aid visual comparison, but that presentation rotation is never applied to canonical coordinates.

South-campus roofs, paths, and bed grids have the clearest orthophoto evidence; north-campus collection polygons are deliberately lower-confidence, schematic-located interpretations pending field or plan verification.
operatorNotes: Control-point coordinates record the completed revision-3 orthophoto trace across both campus areas and allow drift to be detected in tests.

The direct-observation residual measures reproducibility of the stored local-to-CRS84 conversion, not the real-world positional accuracy of interpreted garden edges; use the garden API's 15-foot estimate and per-feature confidence when communicating accuracy.
When replacing these observations, increment both this calibrationRevision and the garden API layoutCalibration revision so saved starter layouts can migrate safely.
